seeds.title: branches.py parse: a letter suffix after the slice id parses as a slice
seeds.detail: parse sdlc/S-002x prints kind slice, id S-002x. The slice row accepts S-[A-Za-z0-9-]+ on purpose (split ids, fix ids), so a user branch like sdlc/S-002x triggers a rename ask. No spec text forbids it.

seeds.title: branches.py parse: unicode digits count as run numbers
seeds.detail: parse sdlc/run-U+0663 prints kind run. The pattern uses \d, which matches non-ASCII digits. list --kind run would count that branch, and n+1 could then name a different branch. A [0-9] class would close it.

seeds.title: branches.py: a trailing newline matches the $ anchor
seeds.detail: parse sdlc/S-002 plus newline prints kind slice. Git refuses such names, so no real branch triggers it. Use \Z for an exact match.
